review_method: Explicit cross-source review of the exact MyBallot candidate ID, full name, election, office, district and party against official member records and Alethical’s stored government member URL. Different-office and joint-ticket links additionally require a positive identity bridge retained in identity_evidence, such as the campaign biography reached from the official candidate record. These entries are confirmations, not a name-matching rule.
